svg.text: Smart Parking Garage UML class diagram
24 top level production types | 13 subsystem classes | Arrows show associations or dependencies
Shared storage and exceptions infrastructure outside the subsystem class counts
+ public - private ~ package access | Constructors and routine accessors are compacted in the boxes.
No A, B or C class imports another domain subsystem. Facades perform the cross-subsystem coordination.
GarageApplication implements AutoCloseable and creates the graph; the CLI calls the two facade APIs.
ParkingException and StorageException extend RuntimeException. Clock, Path and FileLock are JDK types.
Solid arrows: references/calls. Dashed arrows: dependencies. Hollow triangle: interface realization.
Entity status transition methods enforce legal state changes independently of either facade.
